description: This file defines the IgnoredErrors class, which manages a set of boolean flags indicating specific types of errors or conditions that should be ignored in spreadsheet cell processing.

classes.name: IgnoredErrors
classes.description: A class that encapsulates various error ignore flags related to spreadsheet cell data, such as ignoring formula errors, two-digit years, or errors stored as text.

methods.name: setNumberStoredAsText
methods.description: Sets whether numbers stored as text should be ignored.

methods.name: getNumberStoredAsText
methods.description: Retrieves whether numbers stored as text are being ignored.

methods.name: setFormula
methods.description: Sets whether formula errors should be ignored.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Checks if formula errors are set to be ignored.

methods.name: setTwoDigitTextYear
methods.description: Sets whether two-digit text years should be ignored.

methods.name: getTwoDigitTextYear
methods.description: Checks if two-digit text years are set to be ignored.

methods.name: setEvalError
methods.description: Sets whether evaluation errors should be ignored.

methods.name: getEvalError
methods.description: Checks if evaluation errors are set to be ignored.
